name: 特別対策本部 (Tokubetsu Taisaku Honbu)
description: "Special Countermeasures Headquarters" — the chartered civil-defence directorate that runs the Frame program, operating under its own oversight council. Commonly shortened to "the Directorate" or "Honbu" in English use; both are standing shorthand for the same organisation, not separate entities. Legitimate and procedural — not a hidden conspiracy so much as an institution that doesn't fully understand what it's excavated either.

sharedResources.technicianDayPool: A single shared weekly pool that funds Frame repairs, Frame modifications, and every Caretaker-won accommodation for the kids. All three compete for the same finite resource — see campaign/config.json frameEconomy and timeEconomy.
